title: agsc.config.json
description: The single configuration file of a Bundle (AGSC-01-17). Unlike item frontmatter, configuration is CLOSED: additionalProperties is false and an unknown top-level key is error AGSC-E004 (AGSC-01-18). There is no second configuration file. CC0-1.0.

base.description: Absolute https origin without a trailing slash; the IRI base of every item (AGSC-01-19).

analytics_token.description: Edge analytics token only. No beacon, cookie or third-party script may be emitted (AGSC-06-05).

base.description: Vocabulary hash namespace; the site domain MUST NOT appear here (AGSC-05-02).

releases.description: Boolean switchboard; an item with release: <key> publishes only when its key is true (AGSC-01-20).

allowed.description: The closed tag vocabulary; a tag outside it is AGSC-E203 (AGSC-01-21).

rdfxml.description: Emit /graph.rdf; default false, the only should-level RDF view (AGSC-05-06, AGSC-06-01).

injection_patterns.description: Literal alternations only, never user-supplied regular expressions (AGSC-08-14).

human_actor.description: AGSC-01-25: the accountable operator of this Bundle, human:<id> only; the first source of prov.operator at adoption (AGSC-02-90).
